caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition on a textured beige background. The central element at the top is a stylized cross, outlined in red with a gold fill and light blue decorative patterns inside. Behind the cross are yellow rays resembling light or energy. Beneath the cross, a large bow shape with four loops is depicted, outlined in blue and red and filled with yellow, embellished with red dots and a central circular motif with blue and yellow sections. On either side of the bow, there are two gold wing-like shapes with three red-tipped features resembling feathers or fingers. Below these, at the bottom of the image, is a large circular medallion with a symmetrical mandala-like design incorporating colors gold, red, and blue. The circular medallion contains radiating triangular and petal shapes in repeating patterns around concentric circles. The overall color palette consists of beige, gold, red, blue, and yellow tones.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
